blocks.html: Pick where ATAK gets your position from — internal GPS, Wi-Fi/cell, or an external receiver — so your dot on the map stays accurate.

slides.title: Choose your position source
slides.html:
Open the Location Input Manager to see every provider with a short description. Tick the Enabled checkbox to turn a source on or off:

  • Internal GNSS/GPS Receiver — the device's own GPS chip.
  • WiFi/Cell Signal Derived (NETD) — position from cell towers and Wi-Fi.
  • Serial Monitor Input — an external/serial GPS receiver.

slides.title: Set the priority order
slides.html: Drag the grey bar on the left of a provider up or down to reorder it. ATAK uses the first provider in the list and falls back to the next one if it can't get a fix.
